description.value: A Naramata Bench winery established in the 1990s, crafting a range of BC VQA whites, reds, and rosés. The tasting room sits right along the popular Naramata cycling corridor, making it a natural stop for touring cyclists riding the bench. They host regular events including live music, comedy shows, and seasonal festivals.

address.value: 891 Naramata Bench Rd, Penticton, BC V2A 8T5
